shared_elements: bird form (bird's head in profile in A's hieroglyphic signs; frontal bird in B)
sun disc with rays (A) vs central bosses (B) — only loosely comparable
symmetrical arrangement about a vertical axis
schematic outlined figures with internal linear detail
justification: A shows a rounded-top stele with a small offering scene of standing human figures adoring a rayed disc above many dense registers of script signs (which include profile bird glyphs), while B shows a single large frontal bird of prey with outspread wings, a hooked beak in profile, taloned feet and central bosses. The only correspondence is the incidental presence of bird imagery and a bilaterally symmetrical layout; there is no shared scene, no shared relationship between elements, and completely different modes of depiction (dense inscribed registers vs a single heraldic creature).
